newsitem.title: INDIA: India to convert reconstruction bank into company.
newsitem.headline: India to convert reconstruction bank into company.

text.p: Indian President Shankar Dayal Sharma has issued an ordinance to convert the state-run Industrial Reconstruction Bank of India (IRBI) into a company, a government statement said on Monday.
After the change, the IRBI, which is now directly owned by the government, would be able to issue shares, through which its ownership will be registered.
The conversion would enable IRBI to better mobilise resources and reshape its business strategy, the statement said.
Market analysts say the conversion of government agencies into companies enables the government to undertake the privatisation of state-owned companies through the issue of shares to the public.
Finance Minister P. Chidambaram in his 1996/97 (April/March) general budget had proposed converting IRBI into an all-purpose development finance institution.
India has already converted the Industrial Finance Corporation of India (IFCI) into a company, IFCI Ltd which has issued shares.
